defects: Drops the universal quantification over an arbitrary CommRing R (with a TopologicalSpace on R⟦X⟧); the produced statement is specialized to R = ℚ only, a strictly weaker claim than the gold's ∀ R statement.

Replaces the gold's `HasSum (…) (pentagonalSeries R)` (which asserts actual convergence/summability of the alternating series to the product) with a plain `tsum` equality `∑' k, … = ∏' n, …`; tsum defaults to 0 when the family is not summable, so this equality does not by itself assert the same convergence content as HasSum.

No topology is specified/opened for the power series ring in the produced statement (unlike gold which brings in `WithPiTopology`), so it is unclear which (if any) TopologicalSpace instance the `∑'`/`∏'` notations resolve to — this likely fails to elaborate or silently uses an unintended instance.

Uses an ad hoc reimplementation `g k := (k*(3*k-1)/2).natAbs` instead of citing Mathlib's own `pentagonal` definition used in the gold statement, so equivalence to `pentagonal` is only guaranteed if the definitions happen to coincide.
